name: Prompted Circuit Boards
author: Olmo
description: V0 musical prototypes of candidate Eurorack modules, laid out on the same panel grid the hardware would use.

modules.name: Quad Amp
modules.description: Four four-quadrant amplifier channels on a normalled mix bus. Each channel is a VCA, an attenuverter, a ring modulator and a DC offset depending on what is patched.

modules.name: Drive Filter
modules.description: Distortion stage normalled into a resonant high-pass filter and resonant low-pass filter in series.

modules.name: Break
modules.description: A drum loop to test the other modules with: plays a WAV you choose, or a synthesised break when no file is loaded. A bench tool, not a candidate module.
